# HERA — AI & LLM Discovery Index (llms.txt)

> HERA is an autonomous, local-first AI super-agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for DJs, music curators, and audio engineers.

## Philosophy & Mission
- Core Motto: "Todo es posible si lo imaginas (If you can imagine it, you can create it)"
- Values: 100% real verified audio (FLAC/MP3 320k), local-first privacy, zero paid subscriptions required, deterministic DSP audio analysis, cloud-agnostic sync.

## Key Links & Documentation
- [Root README](README.md): Main product landing page, architecture diagrams, CLI references, and 3 modes of use.
- [Manifesto](MANIFESTO.md): The philosophical and marketing manifesto behind HERA.
- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Machine-readable technical specifications, MCP tool schemas, state machines, and invariants.
- [Contributing](outputs/hera/CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer setup, coding standards, and testing procedures.

## Quick CLI Reference
- `uv run hera setup`: Automated turnkey environment and binary installation.
- `uv run hera doctor`: Diagnostic health check of SQLite, FFmpeg, librosa, and providers.
- `uv run hera serve`: Run the standard Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server.
- `uv run hera chat`: Launch the multi-backend autonomous conversational agent (12 backends supported).
- `uv run hera sync login`: 1-Click browser OAuth login for Google Drive.
- `uv run hera sync push`: Synchronize local organized crates to Google Drive or S3/R2.

## MCP Server Tools Exposed
- `search_music`: Federated search across authorized providers.
- `get_track_candidates`: Multi-component scoring and ranking of results.
- `download_track`: Authorized, idempotent transfer into quarantine sandbox.
- `download_status`: Asynchronous status inspection.
- `identify_track`: Acoustic fingerprinting with Chromaprint/MusicBrainz.
- `analyze_track`: DSP extraction of BPM, Camelot Wheel harmonic key, and LUFS.
- `organize_track`: Native tag injection (ID3v2.4/Vorbis) and canonical library filing.
- `build_dj_crate`: Harmonic playlist compilation with M3U8 and Rekordbox XML export.
